name: Swift Block 3x3 Super Maglev
reviews: Hướng tới cả người mới và người chơi nâng cao
description: The Swift Block Super MagLev UV 3x3 is the latest evolution in GAN's entry-level Swift Block series, designed for speedcubers who crave top-tier performance at an accessible price. Featuring state-of-the-art MagLev technology, this cube offers frictionless, magnet-driven repulsion and attraction for lightning-fast, smooth turning—helping you unleash your full potential with every solve.
